content.what_it_is: A Makefile for preprocessing, compiling, linking, archiving, and cleaning FUNWAVE-GPU/FUNWAVE-TVD Fortran sources. The active configuration builds funwave_mpi with mpif90, double precision, parallel and Cartesian macros, PGI and timing macros, and PGI CUDA/cuSPARSE compiler options; it lists module and main source sets and defines executable, tarfile, clean, and clobber rules (lines 1-111).
entities: Core shell, preprocessor, and executable variables (lines 1-4)
Precision and feature macro selection block (lines 5-29)
.F to .o preprocessing and compilation suffix rule (lines 62-70)
FUNWAVE-TVD MODS and MAIN source groups (lines 71-85)

equations.ref: Preprocessing flag concatenation across continuation lines

calls: mpif90 links OBJS and LIBS into EXEC (line 92)
tar cvf creates funwave_tvd.tar from *.F and Makefile_cuda (line 101)
clobber invokes clean and removes .f90, .o, and EXEC (lines 110-111)
unresolved: CPPARGS references FLAG_4 through FLAG_24, but several are merely commented out and FLAG_5 plus FLAG_21-FLAG_24 have no definitions anywhere in this Makefile (lines 14-29, 47-53); behavior depends on make treating or externally supplying them as empty values.

INCS and LIBS definitions are commented out (lines 58-59), and LDFLAGS is not defined in this file, although the compile/link recipes reference INCS, LDFLAGS, and LIBS (lines 69, 92); their external or empty resolution is not documented here.
The -DUSE_CUDA feature macro is commented out (line 27), while active OPT flags request CUDA compilation and cuSPARSE (line 37); the Makefile does not explain whether USE_CUDA must also be enabled.
